texts.zh:
灵能能力在我们人口中的不均衡分布正在引发新的社会矛盾。

那些对新获得的能力控制得更好的人开始认为自己高人一等，因此理应享有各种政治和经济特权。他们的分裂言论越来越激进，并有可能演变成暴力。
texts.en:
The uneven distribution of psionic abilities among our population is causing new forms of social conflict.

Those with better control over their newfound powers have come to view themselves as superior and thus deserving of various political and economic privileges. Their divisive rhetoric is increasingly aggressive and threatens to turn violent.
